222:     fn process(&mut self) {
223:         // Check if the pipe is ready to read and therefore has "woken" us up
224:         //
225:         // To do so, we will `poll_read_ready` with a noop waker, since we don't
226:         // need to actually be notified when read ready...
227:         let waker = unsafe { Waker::from_raw(RawWaker::new(ptr::null(), &NOOP_WAKER_VTABLE)) };
228:         let mut cx = Context::from_waker(&waker);
229: 
230:         self.run_wakeup_bookkeeping();
231: 
232:         let ev = match self.receiver.poll_self_pipe_ready(&mut cx) {
233:             Poll::Ready(Ok(ev)) => ev,
234:             Poll::Ready(Err(e)) => panic!("reactor gone: {}", e),
235:             Poll::Pending => return, // No wake has arrived, bail
236:         };
237: 
238:         // Drain the pipe completely so we can receive a new readiness event
239:         // if another signal has come in.
240:         let mut buf = [0; 128];
241:         loop {
242:             match (&*self.receiver).read(&mut buf) {
243:                 Ok(0) => panic!("EOF on self-pipe"),
244:                 Ok(_) => continue, // Keep reading
245:                 Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,
246:                 Err(e) => panic!("Bad read on self-pipe: {}", e),
247:             }
248:         }
249: 
250:         self.receiver.clear_self_pipe_ready(ev);
251: 
252:         // Broadcast any signals which were received
253:         globals().broadcast();
254:     }
255: }
